title: EverydayScience BeverageCooling

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed beverage cooling analysis. Implemented Python scripts to explore data, identify three cooling phases separated by interventions, fit Newton's Law of Cooling to each phase (all showing perfect fits with k=0.0116 min⁻¹), generated multiple visualizations, and produced comprehensive research report with methodology, results, and discussion. All deliverables created: analysis code in code/, figures in report/images/, and final report as report/report.md.
